title: Muisca Raft (Balsa muisca)

date.label: Muisca period; museum reference gives a broad pre-Hispanic/late Muisca range

discovery.note: Found in a ceramic container inside a small cave in the páramo of Pasca, Cundinamarca—not at Lake Guatavita.

repository: Museo del Oro, Banco de la República, Bogotá
summary: Gold votive raft with figures, produced by lost-wax casting. It is traditionally interpreted as a representation of a Guatavita chiefly investiture ceremony, but its Pasca findspot and broad dating prevent treating it as direct proof of a specific Lake Guatavita event.
uncertainty: Exact manufacture date is not precise enough to link the object to one named investiture event.
The scene-to-Guatavita identification is an interpretation, not direct event provenance.
